description.p: OpenGHub configures Logitech gaming peripherals over HID++ 2.0, in the interface G HUB users know: DPI and polling rate, LIGHTSYNC lighting with screen and audio effects, button assignments and macros written to on-board memory, per-game profiles, community profiles, Lua scripting and firmware updates.
Racing wheels get operating range, centering spring, pedal curves, a userspace force-feedback driver and a gamepad mode for games without wheel support.
OpenGHub is not affiliated with or endorsed by Logitech.
